defaults.description: Applied to every client that does not override the field.

issuerBase.description: Kanidm OpenID base URL; the client name is appended. Defaults to https://idm.anurag.sh/oauth2/openid.

clients.description: One KanidmOAuth2Client per entry, plus an Envoy SecurityPolicy when securityPolicy is set.

namespace.description: Namespace the resources are created in. Defaults to the release namespace.

scopeMapGroup.description: Kanidm group granted scopes when scopeMaps is not set. Defaults to platform_admins.

scopes.description: OIDC scopes. Defaults to openid, email, profile.

secretKeys.description: Key names in the written secret. Defaults to client-id and client-secret, which Envoy expects.

name.description: Kanidm resource server name; also names the KanidmOAuth2Client.

displayName.description: Name shown in Kanidm. Defaults to name.

host.description: Public hostname of the app, used for the origin and redirect URL.

callbackPath.description: Redirect path on host. Defaults to /oauth2/callback.

enableLegacyCrypto.description: Sign tokens with RS256 instead of ES256.

scopeMaps.description: Group name to scopes. Overrides scopeMapGroup and scopes.

claimMaps.description: Claim name to group-derived values, passed through verbatim.

secretName.description: Secret to write. Defaults to kanidm-<name>-oidc.

secretNamespace.description: Namespace of the written secret. Defaults to namespace.

securityPolicy.description: Creates an Envoy SecurityPolicy named <name>-oidc that puts OIDC in front of the route.

httpRoute.description: HTTPRoute to protect. Defaults to name.
